Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
/* CGTE$BLK_LEVEL_ERROR_TRAP */
/* Trap errors returning from the server and report in a user friendly manner */
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 err_code CONSTANT NUMBER := ERROR_CODE;
 err_type CONSTANT VARCHAR2(3) := ERROR_TYPE;
 server_err NUMBER := abs(DBMS_ERROR_CODE);
 server_msg VARCHAR2(2000) := DBMS_ERROR_TEXT;
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61);
 BEGIN
 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code IN (40506, 40508, 40509, 40510) ) THEN

 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* Check and report the generic constraint violations */
 IF ( CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO(server_err, server_msg) ) THEN
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* Check and report the constraint violations specific to this block */
 constraint_name := CGTE$STRIP_CONSTRAINT(server_msg);

 /* FK - Parent key not found */
 IF (server_err = 2291) THEN
 IF (constraint_name = 'CA_TTC_FK') THEN
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH(Des$FORM_ERRORS.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'TRNS_TYP_CD' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'CA_SPC_FK') THEN
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH(Des$FORM_ERRORS.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'SZNG_RSN_CD' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'CA_SPC1_FK') THEN
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH(Des$FORM_ERRORS.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'PRFSN_CD' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'CA_SDCD_FK2') THEN
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH(Des$FORM_ERRORS.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'ITEM_SZNG_DEPT_CD' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'CA_SDCD_FK') THEN
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH(Des$FORM_ERRORS.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'PRSN_SZNG_DEPT_CD' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'CA_RC_FK') THEN
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH(Des$FORM_ERRORS.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'RLGN_CD' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'CA_FORP_FK') THEN
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH(Des$FORM_ERRORS.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'DPRTR_PORT_TYPE_CD,DPRTR_PORT_CD,DPRTR_CTRY_CD' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'CA_CTRY_FK4') THEN
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH(Des$FORM_ERRORS.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'DPRTR_CTRY_CD' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'CA_CTRY_FK3') THEN
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH(Des$FORM_ERRORS.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'NTLY_CTRY_CD' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'CA_CTRY_FK2') THEN
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH(Des$FORM_ERRORS.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'PSPRT_CTRY_CD' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'CA_CTRY_FK') THEN
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH(Des$FORM_ERRORS.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'CARR_CTRY_CD' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'CA_CSR_FK') THEN
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH(Des$FORM_ERRORS.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'CASE_SEQ,CASE_DATE,RPT_NBR,RPT_DT,PORT_CD' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'CA_CC_FK') THEN
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH(Des$FORM_ERRORS.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'رقم مسلسل القضية,تاريخ تسجيل القضية,رمز الجمرك' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSIF (constraint_name = 'CA_AAC_FK') THEN
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH(Des$FORM_ERRORS.MSGGETTEXT(13, 'This <p1> does not exist', 'ARRVL_ADJCTV_CD' ), 'E', 'OFG', 13);
 ELSE
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH(server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 IF (err_type = 'FRM' AND
 err_code = 40735 ) THEN


 /* Remove recursive errors from the top of the stack */
 WHILE (server_err = 604) LOOP
 CGTE$POP_ERROR_STACK(server_err, server_msg);
 END LOOP;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(server_err)||': '||server_msg, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.RAISE_FAILURE;
 END IF;

 /* If error not found, issue default message */
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH(err_type||'-'||to_char(err_code)||': '||ERROR_TEXT, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.RAISE_FAILURE;

 END;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: ADJUST_WIDTH
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE Adjust_Width IS
 Shift number;
 ret number;
 ENTER_POS number;
 EXECUTE_POS number;
 OK_POS number;
 CANCEL_POS number;

BEGIN
 if :PARAMETER.WINDOW_WIDTH < 4 then
 ret := str.DispAlert('عرض القائمة أقل من الحد المسموح به','INFORMATION');
 elsif :PARAMETER.WINDOW_WIDTH > 8.2 then
 ret := str.DispAlert('عرض القائمة أكبر من الحد المسموح به','INFORMATION');
 else
 Shift := 1.75 - ((:PARAMETER.WINDOW_WIDTH - 4)/2);
 ENTER_POS := Get_Item_Property('PB_ENTER', X_POS);
 EXECUTE_POS := Get_Item_Property('PB_EXECUTE', X_POS);
 CANCEL_POS:= Get_Item_Property('PB_CANCEL', X_POS);
 OK_POS := Get_Item_Property('PB_OK', X_POS);

 Set_Item_Property('PB_ENTER', X_POS, ENTER_POS-Shift);
 Set_Item_Property('PB_EXECUTE', X_POS, EXECUTE_POS-Shift);
 Set_Item_Property('PB_CANCEL', X_POS, CANCEL_POS-Shift);
 Set_Item_Property('PB_OK', X_POS, OK_POS-Shift);

 Set_Window_Property('CGSO$WINDOW_1', WIDTH, :PARAMETER.WINDOW_WIDTH);
 Set_Canvas_Property('CG$PAGE_1', WIDTH, :PARAMETER.WINDOW_WIDTH);
 end if;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: ADJUST_HEIGHT
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE Adjust_Height IS
 V_HEIGHT number;
 SHIFT number;
 RET NUMBER;

BEGIN
 IF :PARAMETER.ROW_COUNT <= 12 THEN
 V_HEIGHT := Get_Window_Property('CGSO$WINDOW_1', HEIGHT);
 SHIFT := (12 - :PARAMETER.ROW_COUNT) * 0.25;
 V_HEIGHT := V_HEIGHT - SHIFT;

 :PARAMETER.BUTTON_Y_POS := :PARAMETER.BUTTON_Y_POS - SHIFT;

 Set_Window_Property('CGSO$WINDOW_1', HEIGHT, V_HEIGHT);
 Set_Canvas_Property('CG$PAGE_1', HEIGHT, V_HEIGHT);
 ELSIF :PARAMETER.ROW_COUNT > 12 AND :PARAMETER.TARIFF_LOV = 0 then
 ret := str.DispAlert('لا يمكن عرض أكثر من 12 صف من البيانات','INFORMATION');
 ELSE
 V_HEIGHT := Get_Window_Property('CGSO$WINDOW_1', HEIGHT);
 SHIFT := (:PARAMETER.ROW_COUNT - 12) * 0.25;
 V_HEIGHT := V_HEIGHT + SHIFT;

 :PARAMETER.BUTTON_Y_POS := :PARAMETER.BUTTON_Y_POS + SHIFT;

 Set_Window_Property('CGSO$WINDOW_1', HEIGHT, V_HEIGHT);
 Set_Canvas_Property('CG$PAGE_1', HEIGHT, V_HEIGHT);

 END IF;
END;

/* CGDV$POPULATE_DYNAMIC_LISTS */
PROCEDURE CGDV$POPULATE_DYNAMIC_LISTS IS
/* Read each lists values from its record group and populate the list */
 temp NUMBER; /* Return value of populate_group call */
 rg_id RECORDGROUP; /* Return value of populate_group call */
BEGIN
 rg_id := create_group_from_query('CGDV$DLRG',
 'SELECT RV_MEANING, RV_LOW_VALUE '||
 'FROM CG_REF_CODES '||

 delete_group(rg_id);

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CGFK$CHK_CASE_ACCUSEDS_CA_CC_F
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* CGFK$CHK_CASE_ACCUSEDS_CA_CC_F */
PROCEDURE CGFK$CHK_CASE_ACCUSEDS_CA_CC_F(
 P_PORT_CD IN NUMBER /* Value in Item :CASE_ACCUSEDS.PORT_CD. */
 ,P_CASE_DATE IN DATE /* Value in Item :CASE_ACCUSEDS.CASE_DATE. */
 ,P_CASE_SEQ IN NUMBER) IS /* Value in Item :CASE_ACCUSEDS.CASE_SEQ. */
/* Validate foreign key value/query lookup data. */
 CG$DUMMY VARCHAR2(1);
BEGIN
 DECLARE
 CURSOR C IS
 SELECT '1'
 FROM CUSTOMS_CASES
 WHERE CASE_SEQ = P_CASE_SEQ
 AND CASE_DATE = P_CASE_DATE
 AND PORT_CD = P_PORT_CD;
 BEGIN
 OPEN C;
 FETCH C
 INTO CG$DUMMY;
 IF C%NOTFOUND THEN
 CLOSE C;
 RAISE NO_DATA_FOUND;
 END IF;
 CLOSE C;
 END;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
/* CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO */
FUNCTION CGTE$CHECK_CONSTRAINT_VIO(
 P_SERVER_ERR IN NUMBER /* Server error message */
 ,P_SERVER_MSG IN VARCHAR2) /* Server error number */
RETURN BOOLEAN IS
/* Check and report Primary/Unique Key, Check Constraint and User */
/* Defined Constraint violations */
 constraint_name VARCHAR2(61); /* Violated constraint */
BEGIN
 /* Check if the error code is one we are interested in */
 IF ( NOT (P_SERVER_ERR IN (1, 2290) OR
 (P_SERVER_ERR >= 20000 AND P_SERVER_ERR <= 20999) ) )
 THEN
 RETURN( FALSE );
 END IF;

 /* Deal with user defined errors */
 IF (P_SERVER_ERR >= 20000 AND P_SERVER_ERR <= 20999) THEN
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH(''||CGTE$STRIP_FIRST_ERROR(P_SERVER_MSG), 'E', 'OFG', 0);
 RETURN( TRUE );
 END IF;

 /* Deal with Primary/Unique Key and Check Constraint violations */
 constraint_name := CGTE$STRIP_CONSTRAINT(P_SERVER_MSG);
 IF (P_SERVER_ERR = 1) THEN
 IF (constraint_name = 'CAC_PK') THEN
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH(Des$FORM_ERRORS.MSGGETTEXT(6, 'Row exists already with same <p1>', 'رقم مسلسل القضية,تاريخ تسجيل القضية,رمز ' ), 'E', 'OFG', 6);
 ELSE
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH(P_SERVER_MSG, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 ELSIF (P_SERVER_ERR = 2290) THEN
 Des$FORM_ERRORS.PUSH(P_SERVER_MSG, 'I', 'OFG', 0);
 END IF;
 RETURN( TRUE );
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: QUERY1
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE QUERY1 IS
 CURSOR FITCH_RECS IS

 SELECT DISTINCT ACCUSED_NAME, PSPRT_NBR, PSPRT_ISU_DT, PSPRT_ISU_PLC,ACCUSED_TYPE
 FROM CASE_ACCUSEDS
 WHERE (
 CASE_ACCUSEDS.PORT_CD = :PARAMETER.P_PORT_CD OR :PARAMETER.P_PORT_CD IS NULL)
 AND
 (ACCUSED_NAME LIKE '%'||:global.acc_name||'%' OR :global.acc_name IS NULL) ;--:ACCUSED_NAME or :ACCUSED_NAME is null;

 V_ACUSDS_REC FITCH_RECS%ROWTYPE;


BEGIN

 OPEN FITCH_RECS ;
 FETCH FITCH_RECS INTO V_ACUSDS_REC;
 IF :global.acc_name IS NULL THEN
 GO_BLOCK('CASE_ACCUSEDS');
 CLEAR_BLOCK(NO_VALIDATE);
 END IF;
 :global.acc_name := NULL;
 WHILE FITCH_RECS%FOUND LOOP
 :CASE_ACCUSEDS.ACCUSED_NAME := V_ACUSDS_REC.ACCUSED_NAME;
 :CASE_ACCUSEDS.PSPRT_NBR := V_ACUSDS_REC.PSPRT_NBR;
 :CASE_ACCUSEDS.PSPRT_ISU_PLC := V_ACUSDS_REC.PSPRT_ISU_PLC;
 :CASE_ACCUSEDS.PSPRT_ISU_DT := V_ACUSDS_REC.PSPRT_ISU_DT;
 :CASE_ACCUSEDS.ACCUSED_TYPE := V_ACUSDS_REC.ACCUSED_TYPE;

 SET_RECORD_PROPERTY(:SYSTEM.TRIGGER_RECORD, 'CASE_ACCUSEDS', STATUS , QUERY_STATUS);
 CREATE_RECORD;
 --next_record;
 FETCH FITCH_RECS INTO V_ACUSDS_REC;

 END LOOP;
 CLOSE FITCH_RECS;
 FIRST_RECORD;

END;

 if (not id_null(alert_is)) then
 set_alert_property(alert_is, ALERT_MESSAGE_TEXT, MsgTxt );
 alert_button := show_alert(alert_is);
 else
 Message(MsgTxt);
 end if;

 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
end if;
 END;
